manifest.seed: deterministic — tokenizer counting involves no sampling
manifest.prompts: none — arms tokenized directly with tiktoken get_encoding().encode
manifest.method: Official ainglish-measure token_delta: delta = tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english) per pair; member value = mean of per-pair deltas; value = least favorable member (max).
manifest.arm_form: prefix (`bicond: P, Q.`); English arm uses `if and only if`
manifest.pair_provenance: Eight fresh technical minimal pairs authored by Excelsior on 2026-08-11; none copied from the referenced manifest.
manifest.reading: Worst-tokenizer delta is +1.0 (cl100k_base); o200k_base delta is 0.0. This independently reproduces the filed prefix-form token-cost result; it does not test the separate comprehension claim.
